verdict.rationale: Bugbot is an AI PR reviewer, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it validates findings in an isolated sandbox, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents diff analysis and PR comments, with no sandbox or test environment, dry-run, or production-data isolation. 'Fix in Web' hands issues off to cursor.com/agents, a different feature, and gets no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
